005package org.wpilib.command3;
006
007import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
008import java.util.function.Consumer;
009import org.wpilib.annotation.NoDiscard;
010
011/**
012 * A stage in a command builder where requirements and main command execution logic have been set.
013 * No more changes to requirements or command implementation may happen after this point. This is
014 * the final step in command creation
015 */
016@NoDiscard
017public interface NeedsNameBuilderStage {
018  /**
019   * Optionally sets a callback to execute when the command is canceled. The callback will not run
020   * if the command was canceled after being scheduled but before starting to run, and will not run
021   * if the command completes naturally or from encountering an unhandled exception.
022   *
023   * @param onCancel The function to execute when the command is canceled while running. May be
024   *     null.
025   * @return This builder object, for chaining
026   * @see Command#onCancel()
027   */
028  NeedsNameBuilderStage whenCanceled(Runnable onCancel);
029
030  /**
031   * Optionally sets a callback to execute when the command exits. The callback will not run if the
032   * command was stopped after being scheduled but before starting to run, but will run whenever the
033   * command stops regardless of the cause (natural completion, cancellation, or interruption).
034   *
035   * @param onExit The function to execute when the command exits. May be null.
036   * @return This builder object, for chaining
037   * @see Command#onExit()
038   */
039  NeedsNameBuilderStage whenExited(Runnable onExit);
040
041  /**
042   * Sets the priority level of the command.
043   *
044   * @param priority The desired priority level.
045   * @return This builder object, for chaining.
046   */
047  NeedsNameBuilderStage withPriority(int priority);
048
049  /**
050   * Optionally sets an end condition for the command. If the end condition returns {@code true}
051   * before the command body set in {@link NeedsExecutionBuilderStage#executing(Consumer)} would
052   * exit, the command will be canceled by the scheduler.
053   *
054   * @param endCondition An optional end condition for the command. May be null.
055   * @return This builder object, for chaining.
056   */
057  NeedsNameBuilderStage until(BooleanSupplier endCondition);
058
059  /**
060   * Creates the command based on the options set during previous builder stages. The builders will
061   * no longer be usable after calling this method.
062   *
063   * @param name The name of the command
064   * @return The built command.
065   * @throws NullPointerException If {@code name} is null.
066   */
067  Command named(String name);
068}
